forwardedMessage.content: @here Welcome to a new way to share driving videos! To use this tool, first you have to be on a branch ending in `-new` then, type `/clippy` here. Input your Route ID from Comma Connect. Tap and scroll the time frame you want on the clip from comma connect, and copy the link. Paste in the input for clippy. Next, you can select a title, make it private for only you to see, etc. You can share a route as public or private. Upload Rlogs for your route so the driving model path will show!

messages.content: Clippy feels like it takes way too many steps. I never encountered lag from the old record method being too resource heavy. I wish there was a simpler method to get a full video, with overlay, from my C3X to my phone with an easy, super simple, one-button solution.
Please make that tool available if you think a dedicated tool for what you wanted to do (full UI relay with options to export high definitions of recordings) does not work the way you wanted it to.
Because I want it too, and that's called `clippy`
To make it work **on device** is 100% not something we will be spending weeks of time with.
If you have such implementation, we are more than happy to review and consider it.

The previous "Screen Recorder" eats almost half of the resources that the model requires when everything is running. Are you willing to sacrifice model performance for redundant on-device recordings, when `clippy` can do all of this without sacrificing model performance?
Keep in mind models back in 0.9.7 are **not** the same as the ones in 0.10.x.

I'm no developer... And I wasn't bashing anyone or anything. All I was doing was informing the other user about an old feature we used to have and I was lamenting it's loss lol. And then I just said I wish Clippy was more of a one-button solution than what it is now.
